function onMouseButton1Click()
	player.PlayerGui["Game Pass Shop"].CenterFrame.Visible = true
	player.PlayerGui["Game Pass Shop"].CenterFrame.Shop.DevProds.Visible = true
	player.PlayerGui["Game Pass Shop"].CenterFrame.Shop.GamePasses.Visible = false
	player.PlayerGui["Game Pass Shop"].CenterFrame.Shop.CashHelp.Visible = false
	player.PlayerGui["Game Pass Shop"].CenterFrame:TweenPosition(UDim2.new(.5,0,.5,0), "Out", "Quad", .2, true)
	script.Parent.Parent.Parent:TweenPosition(UDim2.new(.5,0,-.5,0), "Out", "Quad", .2, true)
	wait(.2)
	script.Parent.Parent.Parent.Parent:Destroy()
end

[419:PROP:ascii:708] gui = script.Parent.Parent.Parent --the Shop frame

	gui.TouchNotice.Visible = true
end

function onMouseEnter()
	local desc = script.Parent:findFirstChild("ItemDesc")
	local cost = script.Parent:findFirstChild("ItemCost")
	if desc ~= nil and cost ~= nil then
		gui.Desc.ItemDesc.Text = desc.Value
		gui.Desc.ItemCost.Text = "Price: $"..cost.Value
		gui.Desc.ItemName.Text = script.Parent.Name
	end
end

function onMouseButton1Click() --clone the item into their backpack
	itemsbought = gui.ItemsBought
	if touch then
		local desc = script.Parent:findFirstChild("ItemDesc")
		local cost = script.Parent:findFirstChild("ItemCost")
		if desc ~= nil and cost ~= nil then
			gui.Desc.ItemDesc.Text = desc.Value
			gui.Desc.ItemCost.Text = "Price: $"..cost.Value
			gui.Desc.ItemName.Text = script.Parent.Name
		end
		taps = taps + 1
		if taps == 2 then
			taps = 0
			if enabled.Value == true then
			enabled.Value = false
			if player:DistanceFromCharacter(gui.Parent.Parent.ShopPos.Value) < 25 then
				if player:findFirstChild("Backpack") ~= nil then
					tools = player.Backpack:GetChildren()
					if #tools < 10 then
						
							if itemsbought.Value < 6 then
								local purchase = itempurchase:InvokeServer(gui.Parent.Parent.Name,script.Parent.Name)
								if purchase then
									itemsbought.Value = itemsbought.Value + 1
								else
									tmi.Text = "You do not have enough cash! You can earn some cash over time, or purchase more in the Game Pass Shop."
									tmi.Visible = true
									wait(4)
									tmi.Visible = false
								end
							else
								tmi.Text = "You are buying a lot of items - please wait and give the other customers a chance!"
								tmi.Visible = true
								wait(6)
								tmi.Visible =…

[419:PROP:ascii:19755] local Tool = script.Parent;
local Ball = Tool.Handle
local ms = game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetMouse()

enabled = true
function onButton1Down(mouse)
	if not enabled then
		return
	end

	enabled = false
	mouse.Icon = "rbxasset://textures\\GunWaitCursor.png"

	wait(.2)
	mouse.Icon = "rbxasset://textures\\GunCursor.png"
	enabled = true

end

function onEquippedLocal(mouse)


	if mouse == nil then
		print("Mouse not found")
		return 
	end
	Tool.Enabled = true

	mouse.Icon = "rbxasset://textures\\GunCursor.png"
	mouse.Button1Down:connect(function() onButton1Down(mouse) end)
end

Tool.Enabled = true
Tool.Activated:connect(function()
	if ms == nil or not Tool.Enabled then
		return
	end
	local character = Tool.Parent;
	local humanoid = character.Humanoid
	if humanoid == nil then
		print("Humanoid not found")
		return 
	end
	local targetPos = ms.Hit.p
	local lookAt = (targetPos - character.Head.Position).unit
	Tool.ThrowBall:FireServer(lookAt)
	wait(2)
end)


Tool.Equipped:connect(onEquippedLocal)

Tool = script.Parent
Handle = Tool:WaitForChild("Handle")

Players = game:GetService("Players")

RemoteControl = Tool:WaitForChild("RemoteControl")

ServerControl = RemoteControl:WaitForChild("ServerControl")
ClientControl = RemoteControl:WaitForChild("ClientControl")

ToolEquipped = false
MouseControls = {}

ClientControl.OnClientInvoke = (function(Mode, Value)
	if Mode == "PlaySound" and Value then
		Value:Play()
	elseif Mode == "PlaySound" and Value then
		Value:Play()
	elseif Mode == "MousePosition" then
		return PlayerMouse.Hit.p
	end
end)

function InvokeServer(Mode, Value)
	local ServerReturn = nil
	pcall(function()
		ServerReturn = ServerControl:InvokeServer(Mode, Value)
	end)
	return ServerReturn
end

function CheckIfAlive()
	return (((Player and Player.Parent and Humanoid and Humanoid.Parent and Humanoid.Health > 0) and true) or false)
end

function Equipped(Mouse)
	Character = Tool.Parent
	Player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character)
	Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	ToolEquipped = true
	if not CheckIfAlive() then
		return
	end
	PlayerMouse = Mouse
	for i, v in pairs(MouseControls) do
		if v then
			v:disconnect()
		end
	end
	MouseControls = {}
	MouseDown = PlayerMouse.Button1Down:connect(function()
		InvokeServer("MouseClick", {Down = true})
	end)
	MouseUp = PlayerMouse.Button1Up:connect(function()
		InvokeServer("MouseClick", {Down = false})
	end)
end

function Unequipped()
	ToolEquipped = false
	for i, v in pairs(MouseControls) do
		if v then
			v:disconnect()
		end
	end
	MouseControls = {}
end

Tool.Equipped:connect(Equipped)
Tool.Unequipped:connect(Unequipped)

function removeCompanion(plr)
	local pet = workspace:FindFirstChild("Companion_"..plr.Name)
	if pet then
		pet:Destroy()
	end

function renderPet(plr,pet)
	local render
	render = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:connect(function()
		if pet and plr.Parent ~= nil and pet.Parent ~= nil then
			local char = plr.Character
			if char and char.Parent ~= nil and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and char.Humanoid.Health ~= 0 then
				local torso = char.HumanoidRootPart
				local lv = torso.CFrame.lookVector
				pet.BodyPosition.position = torso.Position - (torso.CFrame.lookVector + Vector3.new(lv.x * math.cos(math.pi/2) - lv.z * math.sin(math.pi/2),0,lv.x * math.sin(math.pi/2 - lv.z * math.cos(90)))) * 2.1 + torso.CFrame.lookVector * 2.3 + Vector3.new(0,3.6,0)
				pet.BodyGyro.cframe = torso.CFrame
				if IsInsideArea(torso.Position,"School") == true then
					local t = game.Lighting:GetMinutesAfterMidnight()
					local day = game.ReplicatedStorage.Day.Value
					if t > 420 and t < 900 and day >= 2 and day <= 6 then
						pet.Transparency = 1
					else
						pet.Transparency = 0
					end
				else
					pet.Transparency = 0
				end
			end
		else
			if pet and pet.Parent ~= nil then
				pet:Destroy()
			end
			render:disconnect()
		end
	end)
end

			p.Size=Vector3.new(spraysize,spraysize,.2)
		elseif surface==Enum.NormalId.Left or surface==Enum.NormalId.Right then
			p.Size=Vector3.new(.2,spraysize,spraysize)

			p.Size=Vector3.new(spraysize,.2,spraysize)
		end
		local w=Instance.new("Weld")
		w.Part0=target
		w.Part1=p
		local cf=CFrame.new(target.CFrame:pointToObjectSpace(mousepos))
		w.C0=cf
		w.C1=CFrame.new(0,0,0)

		game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(p,60)
		p.Parent=game.Workspace
	end
end)
[419:PROP:ascii:97362] local plr = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local teleportevent = game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions:WaitForChild("TeleportToMarker")

function standUp(char)
	if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
		char.Humanoid.Jump = true
		char.Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
	end
end

function checkIfStanding(char)
	if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
		if char.Humanoid.SeatPart == nil and char.Humanoid.PlatformStand == false then
			return true
		else
			return false
		end
	end
end

function teleport(locationname)
	local locations = workspace:WaitForChild("TeleportLocations")
	local location = locations:FindFirstChild(locationname)
	if locationname:match("!home_") then
		location = workspace:FindFirstChild(locationname)
		if location and checkIfStanding(plr.Character) then
			location = location.Floor.CFrame + (location.Floor.CFrame.lookVector * 32) + Vector3.new(0,4,0)
		end
	elseif location then
		location = location.CFrame
	end
	if locationname:match("spawn_") then
		local teamname = string.sub(locationname,7)
		for _,v in pairs(game.Teams:GetChildren()) do
			if v.Name == teamname then
				for _,x in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
					if x:IsA("SpawnLocation") and x.TeamColor == v.TeamColor and checkIfStanding(plr.Character) then
						location = x.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,4,0)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if location then
		local char = plr.Character
		if char ~= nil and char.Parent ~= nil and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
			if checkIfStanding(char) == true then
				char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = location
			else
				standUp(char)
				wait(1/20)
				if checkIfStanding(char) == true then
					char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = location
					char.HumanoidRootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

	if point.x < 0 or point.x > bx or point.y < 0 or point.y > by then
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

function CreateNametag(v,name,input)
	if v and v.Character and v.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
		DestroyNametag(v)
		
		local nameval = Instance.new("StringValue")
		nameval.Name = "nameval"
		nameval.Value = name 
		nameval.Parent = v
		local descval = Instance.new("StringValue")
		descval.Name = "descval"
		descval.Value = input
		descval.Parent = v
		
		local char = v.Character
		local model = Instance.new("Model", char) 
		if input == nil or input == "" then
			model.Name = name.." (" ..v.Name.. ")"
		else
			model.Name = name.." (" ..v.Name.. ")  -  "..input
		end
		
		local cl = char.Head:Clone() cl.Parent = model cl.face:Destroy() local hum = Instance.new("Humanoid", model) hum.Name = "NameTag" hum.MaxHealth = 0 hum.Health = 0
		local weld = Instance.new("Weld", cl) weld.Part0 = cl weld.Part1 = char.Head
		char.Head.Transparency = 1
	end
end

function DestroyNametag(v)
	if v and v.Character and v.Character:findFirstChild("Head") then 
	for a, mod in pairs(v.Character:children()) do if mod:findFirstChild("NameTag") then v.Character.Head.Transparency = 0 mod:Destroy() end end
	end
	local nameval = v:FindFirstChild("nameval")
	local descval = v:FindFirstChild("descval")
	if nameval then
		nameval:Destroy()
	end
	if descval then
		descval:Destroy()
	end
end

game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.ChangeRPNameOnClient.OnClientEvent:connect(function(v,name,input)
	CreateNametag(v,name,input)
end)

game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.RemoveRPNameOnClient.OnClientEvent:connect(function(v)
	DestroyNametag(v)
end)

function InvokeServer(RemoteFunction, Mode, Value)
	local ServerReturn = nil
	pcall(function()
		ServerReturn = RemoteFunction:InvokeServer(Mode, Value)
	end)
	return ServerReturn
end

function DoSkateboard(action)
	local Skateboard = SkateboardValue.Value
		if Skateboard then
			local SkateboardPlatform = Skateboard:FindFirstChild("SkateboardPlatform")
			if SkateboardPlatform then
				local RemoteControl = SkateboardPlatform:FindFirstChild("RemoteControl")
				if RemoteControl then
					local ServerControl = RemoteControl:FindFirstChild("ServerControl")
					if ServerControl then
						if action == "PickUp" then
							Spawn(function()
								InvokeServer(ServerControl, "KeyPress", {Key = "Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl", Down = true})
								wait(0.001)
								InvokeServer(ServerControl, "KeyPress", {Key = "Enum.KeyCode.P", Down = true})
							end)
						elseif action == "Dismount" then
							InvokeServer(ServerControl, "KeyPress", {Key = "Backspace", Down = true})
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
end

[419:PROP:ascii:134017] function displayEffect(origin,destination,islocal,orb)
	
	if orb then
		local handle = orb:FindFirstChild("Handle")
		if handle then
			local pe = handle:FindFirstChild("ParticleEmitter")
			if pe then
				pe:Emit(20)
			end
		end
	end
	
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.FormFactor = "Symmetric"
	part.Shape = "Ball"
	part.Size = Vector3.new(1,1,1)
	part.BrickColor = BrickColor.Blue()
	part.Transparency = .3
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.TopSurface = "Smooth"
	part.BottomSurface = "Smooth"
	
	local p1,p2 = part:clone(),part:clone()
	p1.CFrame = CFrame.new(origin)
	p2.CFrame = CFrame.new(destination)
	p1.Parent,p2.Parent = workspace,workspace
	
	game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(p1,.5)
	game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(p2,.5)
	
	if islocal then
		script.Teleport:Play()
	else
		local sound = script.Teleport:clone()
		sound.Parent = p2
		sound:Play()
	end
	
	for i=1,6 do
		wait(1/30)
		p1.Size = p1.Size + Vector3.new(1,1,1)
		p1.CFrame = CFrame.new(origin)
		p2.Size = p2.Size + Vector3.new(1,1,1)
		p2.CFrame = CFrame.new(destination)
		if islocal then
			script.TeleBlue.Frame.BackgroundTransparency = script.TeleBlue.Frame.BackgroundTransparency - .06
		end
	end
	
	for i=1,6 do
		wait(1/30)
		p1.Size = p1.Size - Vector3.new(1,1,1)
		p1.CFrame = CFrame.new(origin)
		p2.Size = p2.Size - Vector3.new(1,1,1)
		p2.CFrame = CFrame.new(destination)
		if islocal then
			script.TeleBlue.Frame.BackgroundTransparency = script.TeleBlue.Frame.BackgroundTransparency + .06
		end
	end
	
	wait(1/30)
	if p1 and p2 then
		p1:Destroy()
		p2:Destroy()
	end
	
end

function PlayBell()
	if torso and workspace:FindFirstChild("TeleportLocations") and workspace.TeleportLocations:FindFirstChild("schoolfront") then
		local vol = 0
		if isInSchool(torso.Position) then
			vol = 1
		else
			local dist = (torso.Position - workspace.TeleportLocations.schoolfront.Position).magnitude
			vol = 1 - (dist / 450)
			if dist > 350 then
				vol = 0
			end
		end
		local sound = Instance.new("Sound",script)
		sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://345830614"
		sound.Volume = vol
		sound:Play()
	end
end

function OpenWindow()
	frame.Visible = true
	frame:TweenPosition(openpos,nil,nil,1.3,true)
	PlayBell()
end

function StartClosingWindow()
	frame:TweenPosition(peekingpos,nil,nil,4,true)
	wait(4)
end

function CloseWindow()
	frame:TweenPosition(closedpos,nil,nil,1.3,true)
	wait(1.3)
	frame.Visible = false
end

	CloseWindow()
end)

function sendMessage()
	local threadview = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
	local error = script.Parent.Parent.Error
	local input = script.Parent.Text
	if input ~= "Type in a message" and input ~= " " and input ~= "" then
		local targetplr = game.Players:FindFirstChild(string.sub(threadview.Name,8))
		if targetplr and targetplr:FindFirstChild("textingdata") then
			
			local thread = targetplr.textingdata.messages:FindFirstChild(plr.Name)
			local localthread = plr.textingdata.messages:FindFirstChild(targetplr.Name)
			
			threadview.TextInput.InputBox.Text = ""
			local result,reason = game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.SendTextMessage:InvokeServer(targetplr,thread,input)

	if property == "TimeOfDay" then
		local tod = game.Lighting.TimeOfDay
		local hours = tonumber(string.sub(tod,1,2))

function clearAllButtons()
	for i,v in pairs(frame:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name ~= "BaseButton" then
			v:Destroy()
		end
	end
	frame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
end

function createButton(obj)
	local button = frame.BaseButton:clone()
	local num = #frame:GetChildren() - 1
	button.Name = obj.Name --the numerical ID
	button.SongName.Text = "Song ID: "..obj.Name.." [Loading...]"
	if data.SongLists.Favorites:FindFirstChild(obj.Name) then
		--is favorited
		button.FavButton.ImageTransparency = 0
		button.Favorited.Value = true
	end
	button.Position = button.Position + UDim2.new(0,0,0,36*num)
	button.Visible = true
	button.Parent = frame
	frame.CanvasSize = frame.CanvasSize + UDim2.new(0,0,0,36)
	if obj.Value == "" then
		local name
		pcall(function()
			local asset = game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):GetProductInfo(tonumber(obj.Name))
			if asset then
				name = asset.Name
			end
		end)
		if name then
			obj.Value = name
		else
			obj.Value = "NULL"
		end
	end
	if obj and obj.Value ~= "NULL" and button and button:FindFirstChild("SongName") then
		button.SongName.Text = obj.Value
	end
end

[419:PROP:ascii:275564] local oldtext = script.Parent.Text

function getSpecialCharacters(name)
	for i=1,#name do
		local letter = string.sub(name,i,i)
		if letter:match("%A") and letter ~= " " and letter ~= "." then
			return true
		end
	end
	
	if name ~= "" and not name:match("%a") then
		return true
	end
end

script.Parent.Changed:connect(function(property)
	if property == "Text" then
		local name = script.Parent.Text
		if #name > 15 or getSpecialCharacters(name) == true then
			script.Parent.Text = oldtext
			return
		else
			oldtext = name
		end
	end
end)

function getItemDataFromID(id)
	for i,v in pairs(game.ReplicatedStorage.Objects:GetChildren()) do
		if v.ItemID.Value == id then
			return v
		end
	end
end


function displayWindow(windowname,reason) --reason is optional and only for the errorwarning
	enabled.Value = false
	local window = frame:FindFirstChild(windowname)
	if window then
		if reason ~= nil then
			window.Reason.Text = reason
		end
		window.Visible = true
		repeat wait() until window.Visible == false
	end
	enabled.Value = true
end

function loadSlots(num) --1/4/7/10
	local slot = tonumber(num)
	frame.SelectedPage.Value = slot
	
	for i,v in pairs(outfitslots:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name ~= "BaseSlot" then
			v:Destroy()
		end
	end
	
	for i=slot,slot+2 do
		local outfit = data.Outfits:FindFirstChild(i)
		if outfit then
			local gui = outfitslots.BaseSlot:clone()
			gui.OutfitName.Text = outfit.OutfitName.Value
			if outfit.OutfitName.Value == "" then
				gui.OutfitName.Text = "Empty"
				gui.Load.Visible = false
			end
			gui.NumberLabel.Text = "#"..i
			gui.Position = gui.Position + UDim2.new((#outfitslots:GetChildren() - 1)*.33,0,0,0)
			gui.Name = i
			gui.Parent = outfitslots
			gui.Visible = true
		end
	end
	setOutfitPageColors()
end

[419:PROP:ascii:298519] local oldtext = script.Parent.Text

function getSpecialCharacters(name)
	for i=1,#name do
		local letter = string.sub(name,i,i)
		if letter:match("%A") and letter ~= " " and letter ~= "." then
			return true
		end
	end
	
	if name ~= "" and not name:match("%a") then
		return true
	end
end

script.Parent.Changed:connect(function(property)
	if property == "Text" then
		local name = script.Parent.Text
		if #name > 15 or getSpecialCharacters(name) == true then
			script.Parent.Text = oldtext
			return
		else
			oldtext = name
		end
	end
end)

function getItemDataFromID(id)
	for i,v in pairs(game.ReplicatedStorage.Objects:GetChildren()) do
		if v.ItemID.Value == id then
			return v
		end
	end
end


function displayWindow(windowname,reason) --reason is optional and only for the errorwarning
	enabled.Value = false
	local window = frame:FindFirstChild(windowname)
	if window then
		if reason ~= nil then
			window.Reason.Text = reason
		end
		window.Visible = true
		repeat wait() until window.Visible == false
	end
	enabled.Value = true
end

function loadSlots(num) --1/4/7/10
	local slot = tonumber(num)
	frame.SelectedPage.Value = slot
	
	for i,v in pairs(outfitslots:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name ~= "BaseSlot" then
			v:Destroy()
		end
	end
	
	for i=slot,slot+2 do
		local outfit = data.Outfits:FindFirstChild(i)
		if outfit then
			local gui = outfitslots.BaseSlot:clone()
			gui.OutfitName.Text = outfit.OutfitName.Value
			gui.NumberLabel.Text = "#"..i
			gui.Position = gui.Position + UDim2.new((#outfitslots:GetChildren() - 1)*.33,0,0,0)
			gui.Name = i
			gui.Parent = outfitslots
			gui.Visible = true
		end
	end
	setOutfitPageColors()
end

		end

	end

function getClothingId(valueobj)
	if valueobj.Value ~= 0 then
		local asset
		local origid = valueobj.Value
		pcall(function()
			asset = mp:GetProductInfo(origid)
		end)
		if asset then
			local creator = asset.Creator.CreatorTargetId
			local count = 0
			local success
			local clothingasset
			local groups
			repeat
				pcall(function() clothingasset = mp:GetProductInfo(origid+(count+1)) end)
				if clothingasset and (clothingasset.AssetTypeId == 11 or clothingasset.AssetTypeId == 12) then
					if clothingasset.Creator.CreatorTargetId == creator then
						--surefire hit
						success = true
					elseif clothingasset.Creator.CreatorType == "Group" then
						if groups == nil then
							pcall(function()
								groups = game:GetService("GroupService"):GetGroupsAsync(creator)
							end)
						end
						if groups then
							for _,entry in pairs(groups) do
								if entry["Id"] == clothingasset.Creator.CreatorTargetId then
									success = true
									break
								end
							end
						end
					else
						clothingasset = nil
					end
				else
					clothingasset = nil
				end
				count = count + 1
			until success == true or count > 25
			if success == true then
				valueobj.Value = origid + count
			else
				print("failed to load clothing asset")
			end
		end
	end
end

[419:PROP:ascii:365842] local oldtext = script.Parent.Text

function getSpecialCharacters(name)
	for i=1,#name do
		local letter = string.sub(name,i,i)
		if letter:match("%A") and letter ~= " " and letter ~= "." then
			return true
		end
	end
	
	if name ~= "" and not name:match("%a") then
		return true
	end
end

script.Parent.Changed:connect(function(property)
	if property == "Text" then
		local name = script.Parent.Text
		if #name > 15 or getSpecialCharacters(name) == true then
			script.Parent.Text = oldtext
			return
		else
			oldtext = name
		end
	end
end)

function commanumber(num)
	local num = tostring(num)
	local i = 0
	local finalstring = ""
	for n in string.gmatch(num,"%d") do
		finalstring = finalstring..n
		i = i + 1
		if (#num - i) % 3 == 0 and i ~= #num then
			finalstring = finalstring..","
		end
	end
	return finalstring
end

end

function commanumber(num)
	local num = tostring(num)
	local i = 0
	local finalstring = ""
	for n in string.gmatch(num,"%d") do
		finalstring = finalstring..n
		i = i + 1
		if (#num - i) % 3 == 0 and i ~= #num then
			finalstring = finalstring..","
		end
	end
	return finalstring
end

function GetTimeString(timeleft)
	if timeleft < 0 then
		return "Ends now!"
	end
	
	local d, h, m, s 
	
	d = math.floor(timeleft / 86400)
	if d == 0 then
		d = ""
	else
		d = d..":"
	end
	
	h = math.floor((timeleft / 3600) % 24)
	if h < 10 then
		if h == 0 then
			if d == "" then
				h = ""
			else
				h = "00:"
			end
		else
			if d == "" then
				h = h..":"
			else
				h = "0"..h..":"
			end
		end
	else
		h = h..":"
	end
	
	m = math.floor((timeleft / 60) % 60)
	if m < 10 then
		if m == 0 then
			if h == "" then
				m = "0:"
			else
				m = "00:"
			end
		else
			if h == "" then
				m = m..":"
			else
				m = "0"..m..":"
			end
		end
	else
		m = m..":"
	end
	
	s = timeleft % 60
	if s < 10 then
		s = "0"..s
	end
	
	return d..h..m..s
end

function SetTimeString()
	local timeleft = (jointime + 86400 * 7) - currenttimeobj.Value
	if timeleft <= 0 then
		timelabel.Text = "Offer about to expire!"
	else
		timelabel.Text = "Offer ends in "..GetTimeString(timeleft)
	end
end

SetTimeString()

currenttimeobj.Changed:connect(function()
	SetTimeString()
end)

function GetTimeString(timeleft)
	if timeleft < 0 then
		return "Ends now!"
	end
	
	local d, h, m, s 
	
	d = math.floor(timeleft / 86400)
	if d == 0 then
		d = ""
	else
		d = d..":"
	end
	
	h = math.floor((timeleft / 3600) % 24)
	if h < 10 then
		if h == 0 then
			if d == "" then
				h = ""
			else
				h = "00:"
			end
		else
			if d == "" then
				h = h..":"
			else
				h = "0"..h..":"
			end
		end
	else
		h = h..":"
	end
	
	m = math.floor((timeleft / 60) % 60)
	if m < 10 then
		if m == 0 then
			if h == "" then
				m = "0:"
			else
				m = "00:"
			end
		else
			if h == "" then
				m = m..":"
			else
				m = "0"..m..":"
			end
		end
	else
		m = m..":"
	end
	
	s = timeleft % 60
	if s < 10 then
		s = "0"..s
	end
	
	return d..h..m..s
end

function SetTimeString()
	local timeleft = (jointime + 86400 * 7) - currenttimeobj.Value
	timelabel.Text = GetTimeString(timeleft)
	if timeleft < 86400 then
		timelabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(.85,0,0)
		timelabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	end
end

SetTimeString()

	SetTimeString()
end)

function Teleport(destinationpart)
	local tpgui = Instance.new("ScreenGui",script.Parent)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(2,0,2,0)
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(-.5,0,-.5,0)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0,0,0)
	frame.Parent = tpgui
	
	for i=1,7 do
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = frame.BackgroundTransparency - .15
		wait(1/35)
	end
	
	if destinationpart.Parent.Name == "WarpPipeMadi" and destinationpart.Parent.Parent.Parent ~= workspace then
		--load the island into the workspace
		destinationpart.Parent.Parent.Parent = workspace
	end
	
	hrp.CFrame = destinationpart.CFrame + destinationpart.CFrame.lookVector * 10
	hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
	hrp.Anchored = true
	
	wait(1.6)
	
	hrp.Anchored = false
		
	for i=1,7 do
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = frame.BackgroundTransparency + .15
		wait(1/35)
	end
	
	tpgui:Destroy()
end

function onMouseLeave(hoverSelection)
	if oldButton ~= nil then
		local notSelected = true
		local selectionText = ""
		for key, value in pairs(selectedButtonTable) do
			if oldButton == value then
				notSelected = false
			else
				selectionText = value.BackgroundColor.Name
			end
		end
		if notSelected then
			hoverSelection.Text = selectionText
			oldButton.Parent.BackgroundColor = BrickColor.Black()
		end
	end
	oldButton = nil
end

	onMouseLeave(hoverSelection)
	hoverSelection.Text = guiButton.BackgroundColor.Name
	if guiButton ~= selectedButton then
		guiButton.Parent.BackgroundColor = BrickColor.White()
		oldButton = guiButton
	end
end

	if selectedButtonTable[colorHolder] ~= nil then
		selectedButtonTable[colorHolder].Parent.BackgroundColor = BrickColor.Black()
	end
	guiButton.Parent.BackgroundColor = BrickColor.Yellow()
	colorHolder.BackgroundColor = guiButton.BackgroundColor
	selectionBox.Color = guiButton.BackgroundColor
	selectionLasso.Color = guiButton.BackgroundColor
	Tool.Value.Value = guiButton.BackgroundColor
	selectedButtonTable[colorHolder] = guiButton
	
	onMouseLeavePalette(paletteFrame)

ToolEquipped = false

function SetAnimation(mode, value)
	if mode == "PlayAnimation" and value and ToolEquipped and Humanoid then
		for i, v in pairs(Animations) do
			if v.Animation == value.Animation then
				v.AnimationTrack:Stop()
				table.remove(Animations, i)
			end
		end
		local AnimationTrack = Humanoid:LoadAnimation(value.Animation)
		table.insert(Animations, {Animation = value.Animation, AnimationTrack = AnimationTrack})
		AnimationTrack:Play(value.FadeTime, value.Weight, value.Speed)
	elseif mode == "StopAnimation" and value then
		for i, v in pairs(Animations) do
			if v.Animation == value.Animation then
				v.AnimationTrack:Stop(value.FadeTime)
				table.remove(Animations, i)
			end
		end
	end
end

function CheckIfAlive()
	return (((Character and Character.Parent and Humanoid and Humanoid.Parent and Humanoid.Health > 0 and Player and Player.Parent) and true) or false)
end

	Character = Tool.Parent
	Player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character)
	Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	ToolEquipped = true
	if not CheckIfAlive() then
		return
	end
	PlayerMouse = Player:GetMouse()
end

function Unequipped()
	for i, v in pairs(Animations) do
		if v and v.AnimationTrack then
			v.AnimationTrack:Stop()
		end
	end
	Animations = {}
	ToolEquipped = false
end

	local ServerReturn
	pcall(function()
		ServerReturn = ServerControl:InvokeServer(mode, value)
	end)
	return ServerReturn
end

Tool = script.Parent
Handle = Tool:WaitForChild("Handle")

Players = game:GetService("Players")
RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

Animations = {}
LocalObjects = {}

ServerControl = Tool:WaitForChild("ServerControl")
ClientControl = Tool:WaitForChild("ClientControl")

ToolEquipped = false

function SetAnimation(mode, value)
	if mode == "PlayAnimation" and value and ToolEquipped and Humanoid then
		for i, v in pairs(Animations) do
			if v.Animation == value.Animation then
				v.AnimationTrack:Stop()
				table.remove(Animations, i)
			end
		end
		local AnimationTrack = Humanoid:LoadAnimation(value.Animation)
		table.insert(Animations, {Animation = value.Animation, AnimationTrack = AnimationTrack})
		AnimationTrack:Play(value.FadeTime, value.Weight, value.Speed)
	elseif mode == "StopAnimation" and value then
		for i, v in pairs(Animations) do
			if v.Animation == value.Animation then
				v.AnimationTrack:Stop()
				table.remove(Animations, i)
			end
		end
	end
end

function DisableJump(Boolean)
	if PreventJump then
		PreventJump:disconnect()
	end
	if Boolean then
		PreventJump = Humanoid.Changed:connect(function(Property)
			if Property ==  "Jump" then
				Humanoid.Jump = false
			end
		end)
	end
end

function CheckIfAlive()
	return (((Character and Character.Parent and Humanoid and Humanoid.Parent and Humanoid.Health > 0 and Player and Player.Parent) and true) or false)
end

	Character = Tool.Parent
	Player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character)
	Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	ToolEquipped = true
	if not CheckIfAlive() then
		return
	end
	PlayerMouse = Player:GetMouse()
	Mouse.Button1Down:connect(function()
		InvokeServer("MouseClick", {Down = true})
	end)
	Mouse.Button1Up:connect(function()
		InvokeServer("MouseClick", {Down = false})
	end)
	Mouse.KeyDown:connect(function(Key)
		InvokeServer("KeyPress", {Key = Key, Down = true})
	end)

function CheckTableForString(Table, String)
	for i, v in pairs(Table) do
		if string.find(string.lower(String), string.lower(v)) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function CheckIntangible(Hit)
	local ProjectileNames = {"Water", "Arrow", "Projectile", "Effect", "Rail", "Laser", "Bullet"}
	if Hit and Hit.Parent then
		if ((not Hit.CanCollide or CheckTableForString(ProjectileNames, Hit.Name)) and not Hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function CastRay(StartPos, Vec, Length, Ignore, DelayIfHit)
	local Ignore = ((type(Ignore) == "table" and Ignore) or {Ignore})
	local RayHit, RayPos, RayNormal = game:GetService("Workspace"):FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(Ray.new(StartPos, Vec * Length), Ignore)
	if RayHit and CheckIntangible(RayHit) then
		if DelayIfHit then
			wait()
		end
		RayHit, RayPos, RayNormal = CastRay((RayPos + (Vec * 0.01)), Vec, (Length - ((StartPos - RayPos).magnitude)), Ignore, DelayIfHit)
	end
	return RayHit, RayPos, RayNormal
end

		for i, v in pairs(AnimationTracks) do
			if v.Animation == Animation then

				if v.TrackStopped then
					v.TrackStopped:disconn…

Players = game:GetService("Players")

RemoteControl = Tool:WaitForChild("RemoteControl")

ServerControl = RemoteControl:WaitForChild("ServerControl")
ClientControl = RemoteControl:WaitForChild("ClientControl")

ToolEquipped = false
MouseControls = {}

ClientControl.OnClientInvoke = (function(Mode, Value)
	if Mode == "PlaySound" and Value then
		Value:Play()
	elseif Mode == "PlaySound" and Value then
		Value:Play()
	elseif Mode == "MousePosition" then
		return PlayerMouse.Hit.p
	end
end)

function InvokeServer(Mode, Value)
	local ServerReturn = nil
	pcall(function()
		ServerReturn = ServerControl:InvokeServer(Mode, Value)
	end)
	return ServerReturn
end

function CheckIfAlive()
	return (((Player and Player.Parent and Humanoid and Humanoid.Parent and Humanoid.Health > 0) and true) or false)
end

function Equipped(Mouse)
	Character = Tool.Parent
	Player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character)
	Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	ToolEquipped = true
	if not CheckIfAlive() then
		return
	end
	PlayerMouse = Mouse
	for i, v in pairs(MouseControls) do
		if v then
			v:disconnect()
		end
	end
	MouseControls = {}
	MouseDown = PlayerMouse.Button1Down:connect(function()
		InvokeServer("MouseClick", {Down = true})
	end)
	MouseUp = PlayerMouse.Button1Up:connect(function()
		InvokeServer("MouseClick", {Down = false})
	end)
end

function Unequipped()
	ToolEquipped = false
	for i, v in pairs(MouseControls) do
		if v then
			v:disconnect()
		end
	end
	MouseControls = {}
end

Tool.Equipped:connect(Equipped)
Tool.Unequipped:connect(Unequipped)

Tool = script.Parent
Handle = Tool:WaitForChild("Handle")

Players = game:GetService("Players")
RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

LocalObjects = {}

ServerControl = Tool:WaitForChild("ServerControl")
ClientControl = Tool:WaitForChild("ClientControl")

ToolEquipped = false

function SetAnimation(mode, value)
	if mode == "PlayAnimation" and value and ToolEquipped and Humanoid then
		for i, v in pairs(Animations) do
			if v.Animation == value.Animation then
				v.AnimationTrack:Stop()
				table.remove(Animations, i)
			end
		end
		local AnimationTrack = Humanoid:LoadAnimation(value.Animation)
		table.insert(Animations, {Animation = value.Animation, AnimationTrack = AnimationTrack})
		AnimationTrack:Play(value.FadeTime, value.Weight, value.Speed)
	elseif mode == "StopAnimation" and value then
		for i, v in pairs(Animations) do
			if v.Animation == value.Animation then
				v.AnimationTrack:Stop()
				table.remove(Animations, i)
			end
		end
	end
end

function DisableJump(Boolean)
	if PreventJump then
		PreventJump:disconnect()
	end
	if Boolean then
		PreventJump = Humanoid.Changed:connect(function(Property)
			if Property ==  "Jump" then
				Humanoid.Jump = false
			end
		end)
	end
end

function CheckIfAlive()
	return (((Character and Character.Parent and Humanoid and Humanoid.Parent and Humanoid.Health > 0 and Player and Player.Parent) and true) or false)
end

	Character = Tool.Parent

ClientControl = RemoteControl:WaitForChild("ClientControl")

MouseControls = {}

ClientControl.OnClientInvoke = (function(Mode, Value)
	if Mode == "PlaySound" and Value then
		Value:Play()
	elseif Mode == "PlaySound" and Value then
		Value:Play()
	elseif Mode == "MousePosition" then
		return PlayerMouse.Hit.p
	end
end)

function InvokeServer(Mode, Value)
	local ServerReturn = nil
	pcall(function()
		ServerReturn = ServerControl:InvokeServer(Mode, Value)
	end)
	return ServerReturn
end

function CheckIfAlive()
	return (((Player and Player.Parent and Humanoid and Humanoid.Parent and Humanoid.Health > 0) and true) or false)
end

function Equipped(Mouse)
	Character = Tool.Parent
	Player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character)
	Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	ToolEquipped = true
	if not CheckIfAlive() then
		return
	end
	PlayerMouse = Mouse
	for i, v in pairs(MouseControls) do
		if v then
			v:disconnect()
		end
	end
	MouseControls = {}
	MouseDown = PlayerMouse.Button1Down:connect(function()
		InvokeServer("MouseClick", {Down = true})
	end)
	MouseUp = PlayerMouse.Button1Up:connect(function()
		InvokeServer("MouseClick", {Down = false})
	end)
end

function Unequipped()
	ToolEquipped = false
	for i, v in pairs(MouseControls) do
		if v then
			v:disconnect()
		end
	end
	MouseControls = {}
end

Tool.Equipped:connect(Equipped)
Tool.Unequipped:connect(Unequipped)

[419:PROP:ascii:699270] --Made by Luckymaxer

Tool = script.Parent
Handle = Tool:WaitForChild("Handle")

Players = game:GetService("Players")

RemoteControl = Tool:WaitForChild("RemoteControl")

ServerControl = RemoteControl:WaitForChild("ServerControl")
ClientControl = RemoteControl:WaitForChild("ClientControl")

ToolEquipped = false
MouseControls = {}

ClientControl.OnClientInvoke = (function(Mode, Value)
	if Mode == "PlaySound" and Value then
		Value:Play()
	elseif Mode == "PlaySound" and Value then
		Value:Play()
	elseif Mode == "MousePosition" then
		return PlayerMouse.Hit.p
	end
end)

function InvokeServer(Mode, Value)
	local ServerReturn = nil
	pcall(function()
		ServerReturn = ServerControl:InvokeServer(Mode, Value)
	end)
	return ServerReturn
end

function CheckIfAlive()
	return (((Player and Player.Parent and Humanoid and Humanoid.Parent and Humanoid.Health > 0) and true) or false)
end

function Equipped(Mouse)
	Character = Tool.Parent
	Player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character)
	Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	ToolEquipped = true
	if not CheckIfAlive() then
		return
	end
	PlayerMouse = Mouse
	for i, v in pairs(MouseControls) do
		if v then
			v:disconnect()
		end
	end
	MouseControls = {}
	MouseDown = PlayerMouse.Button1Down:connect(function()
		InvokeServer("MouseClick", {Down = true})
	end)
	MouseUp = PlayerMouse.Button1Up:connect(function()
		InvokeServer("MouseClick", {Down = false})
	end)
end

function Unequipped()
	ToolEquipped = false
	for i, v in pairs(MouseControls) do
		if v then
			v:disconnect()
		end
	end
	MouseControls = {}
end

Tool.Equipped:connect(Equipped)
Tool.Unequipped:connect(Unequipped)

	if not ToolEquipped or not CheckIfAlive() or not mode or not value then
		return
	end
	if mode == "PlayAnimation" then
		for i, v in pairs(Animations) do
			if v.Animation == value.Animation then

			end
		end
		local AnimationTrack = Humanoid:LoadAnimation(value.Animation)
		table.insert(Animations, {Animation = value.Animation, AnimationTrack = AnimationTrack})
		AnimationTrack:Play(value.FadeTime, value.Weight, value.Speed)
	elseif mode == "StopAnimation" and value then
		for i, v in pairs(Animations) do
			if v.Animation == value.Animation then
				v.AnimationTrack:Stop()
				table.remove(Animations, i)
			end
		end
	end
end

	ToolEquipped = true

	while not script:FindFirstChild(childName) do wait() end

local humanoid = nil
local drinker = nil
local con = nil
local enabled = false

function onEquipped(mouse)

	humanoid = Tool.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	local animname = "drink"
	if humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
		animname = "drinkR15"
	end
	if humanoid ~= nil then
		drinker = humanoid:LoadAnimation(Tool[animname])
	end
	con = mouse.Button1Down:connect(function() onButton1Down(mouse) end)

end

function onUnequipped(mouse)
	
	humanoid = nil
	if drinker ~= nil then
		drinker:Destroy()
		drinker = nil
	end
	if con ~= nil then
		con:disconnect()
	end

end

function onButton1Down(mouse)

	if enabled then
		return
	end
	
	enabled = true 

	
	drinker:Play()
	wait(30)

	enabled = false
	

end

[419:PROP:ascii:784075] local plr = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local tool = script.Parent
local mouse = plr:GetMouse() 

local moveincrement = plr:WaitForChild("HouseMoveIncrement")
local rotateincrement = plr:WaitForChild("HouseRotateIncrement")

local dragging = false --can't rotate while dragging

--[[
	local size,cframe = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Modules.GetBoundingBox)(selectedmodel)
	local cover = Instance.new("Part")
	cover.Transparency = 1
	cover.FormFactor = "Custom"
	cover.Size = size
	cover.CFrame = cframe
	cover.Parent = selectedmodel

local selectedmodel
local boundingbox --the box we get from the ModelPositioning module
local gui

function getBoundingBox(remake)
	if selectedmodel == nil or remake then
		if boundingbox ~= nil then
			boundingbox.Parent = nil
		end
		if not remake then return end
	end
	if boundingbox == nil then
		boundingbox = Instance.new("Part")
		boundingbox.Name = "BoundingBox"
		boundingbox.Transparency = 1
		boundingbox.FormFactor = "Custom"
		boundingbox.Anchored = true
		boundingbox.CanCollide = false
	end
	local size,cframe = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Modules.GetBoundingBox)(selectedmodel)
	boundingbox.Size = size
	boundingbox.CFrame = cframe
	boundingbox.Parent = selectedmodel
	return boundingbox
end

enabled = true
function onButton1Down(mouse)

		return
	end

	mouse.Icon = "rbxasset://textures\\GunWaitCursor.png"

local selectionBox
local selectionLasso
local inGui = false
local inPalette = false

local selectedButtonTable = {}
local oldButton = nil
function onMouseLeave(hoverSelection)
	if oldButton ~= nil then
		local notSelected = true
		local selectionText = ""
		for key, value in pairs(selectedButtonTable) do
			if oldButton == value then
				notSelected = false
			else
				selectionText = value.BackgroundColor.Name
			end
		end
		if notSelected then
			hoverSelection.Text = selectionText
			oldButton.Parent.BackgroundColor = BrickColor.Black()
		end
	end
	oldButton = nil
end

function onMouseEnter(hoverSelection, guiButton)
	onMouseLeave(hoverSelection)
	hoverSelection.Text = guiButton.BackgroundColor.Name
	if guiButton ~= selectedButton then
		guiButton.Parent.BackgroundColor = BrickColor.White()
		oldButton = guiButton
	end
end

function onMouseUp(colorHolder, paletteFrame, guiButton)
	if selectedButtonTable[colorHolder] ~= nil then
		selectedButtonTable[colorHolder].Parent.BackgroundColor = BrickColor.Black()
	end
	guiButton.Parent.BackgroundColor = BrickColor.Yellow()
	colorHolder.BackgroundColor = guiButton.BackgroundColor
	selectionBox.Color = guiButton.BackgroundColor
	selectionLasso.Color = guiButton.BackgroundColor
	Tool.Value.Value = guiButton.BackgroundColor
	game.Players.LocalPlayer.HousePaintColor.Value = Tool.Value.Value
	selectedButtonTable[colorHolder] = guiButton
	
	onMouseLeavePalette(paletteFrame)
	
	print("Selected Color: " .. guiButton.BackgroundColor.Name)
end

function onShowColorDialog(paletteFrame)
	paletteFrame.Visible = true
end

	unsetSelectionBox()
	selectionBox.Adornee = part.Parent
	selectionLasso.Part = part.Parent.PrimaryPart
end

--[[ Local Functions ]]--
function MasterControl:GetHumanoid()
	local character = LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.Character
	if character then
		if CachedHumanoid and CachedHumanoid.Parent == character then
			return CachedHumanoid
		else
			CachedHumanoid = nil
			for _,child in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA('Humanoid') then
					CachedHumanoid = child
					return CachedHumanoid
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function assignActivateGamepad()
	local connectedGamepads = UserInputService:GetConnectedGamepads()
	if #connectedGamepads > 0 then
		for i = 1, #connectedGamepads do
			if activateGamepad == nil then
				activateGamepad = connectedGamepads[i]
			elseif connectedGamepads[i].Value < activateGamepad.Value then
				activateGamepad = connectedGamepads[i]
			end
		end
	end
	
	if activateGamepad == nil then -- nothing is connected, at least set up for gamepad1
		activateGamepad = Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1
	end
end

	if prop == "JumpPower" then
		JumpPower =  Humanoid.JumpPower
		updateEnabled()
	elseif prop == "Parent" then
		if not Humanoid.Parent then
			HumChangeConnection:disconnect()
		end
	end
end

	if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
		JumpStateEnabled = isEnabled
		updateEnabled()
	end
end

local Bit = require(lockbox.util.bit);
local String = string;
local Stream = require(lockbox.util.stream);
local Array = require(lockbox.util.array);

local XOR = Bit.bxor;

local HMAC = function()
	
	local public = {};
	local blockSize = 64;
	local Digest = nil;
	local outerPadding = {};
	local innerPadding = {}
	local digest;

	public.setBlockSize = function(bytes)
		blockSize = bytes;
		return public;
	end

	public.setDigest = function(digestModule)
		Digest = digestModule;
		digest = Digest();
		return public;
	end

	public.setKey = function(key)
		local keyStream;

		if(Array.size(key) > blockSize) then
			keyStream = Stream.fromArray(Digest()
						.update(Stream.fromArray(key))
						.finish()
						.asBytes());
		else
			keyStream = Stream.fromArray(key);
		end	

		outerPadding = {};
		innerPadding = {};

		for i=1,blockSize do
			local byte = keyStream();
			if byte == nil then byte = 0x00; end
			outerPadding[i] = XOR(0x5C,byte);
			innerPadding[i] = XOR(0x36,byte);
		end

		return public;
	end

	public.init = function()
		digest	.init()
				.update(Stream.fromArray(innerPadding));
		return public;
	end
	
	public.update = function(messageStream)
		digest.update(messageStream);
		return public;
	end

	public.finish = function()
		local inner = digest.finish().asBytes();
		digest	.init()
				.update(Stream.fromArray(outerPadding))
				.update(Stream.fromArray(inner))
				.finish();

		return public;
	end

	public.asBytes = function()
		return digest.asBytes();
	end
	
	public.asHex = function()
		return digest.asHex();
	end

	return public;

end

return HMAC;

[479:PROP:ascii:68321] local Queue = function()
	local queue = {};	
	local tail = 0;
	local head = 0;

	local public = {};

	public.push = function(obj)
		queue[head] = obj;
		head = head + 1;
		return;		
	end

	public.pop = function()
		if tail < head
		then
			local obj = queue[tail];
			queue[tail] = nil;
			tail = tail + 1;
			return obj;
		else
			return nil;
		end
	end

	public.size = function()
		return head - tail;
	end

	public.getHead = function()
		return head;
	end

	public.getTail = function()
		return tail;
	end

	public.reset = function()
		queue = {};
		head = 0;
		tail = 0;
	end

	return public;
end

return Queue;

local bytes2word = function(b0,b1,b2,b3)
	local i = b0; i = LSHIFT(i,8);
	i = OR(i,b1); i = LSHIFT(i,8);
	i = OR(i,b2); i = LSHIFT(i,8);
	i = OR(i,b3);
	return i;
end

local word2bytes = function(word)
	local b0,b1,b2,b3;
	b3 = AND(word,0xFF); word = RSHIFT(word,8);
	b2 = AND(word,0xFF); word = RSHIFT(word,8);
	b1 = AND(word,0xFF); word = RSHIFT(word,8);
	b0 = AND(word,0xFF);
	return b0,b1,b2,b3;
end

local bytes2dword = function(b0,b1,b2,b3,b4,b5,b6,b7)
	local i = bytes2word(b0,b1,b2,b3);
	local j = bytes2word(b4,b5,b6,b7);
	return (i*0x100000000)+j;
end

local dword2bytes = function(i)
	local b4,b5,b6,b7 = word2bytes(i);
	local b0,b1,b2,b3 = word2bytes(Math.floor(i/0x100000000));
	return b0,b1,b2,b3,b4,b5,b6,b7;
end

[479:PROP:ascii:76229] local M = {_TYPE='module', _NAME='bit.numberlua', _VERSION='0.3.1.20120131'}

M.bits = 32

local floor = math.floor

local MOD = 2^32
local MODM = MOD-1

local function memoize(f)
  local mt = {}
  local t = setmetatable({}, mt)
  function mt:__index(k)
    local v = f(k); t[k] = v
    return v
  end
  return t
end

local function make_bitop_uncached(t, m)
  local function bitop(a, b)
    local res,p = 0,1
    while a ~= 0 and b ~= 0 do
      local am, bm = a%m, b%m
      res = res + t[am][bm]*p
      a = (a - am) / m
      b = (b - bm) / m
      p = p*m
    end
    res = res + (a+b)*p
    return res
  end
  return bitop
end

local function make_bitop(t)
  local op1 = make_bitop_uncached(t,2^1)
  local op2 = memoize(function(a)
    return memoize(function(b)
      return op1(a, b)
    end)
  end)
  return make_bitop_uncached(op2, 2^(t.n or 1))
end

  if disp < 0 then return rshift(a,-disp) end 
  return (a * 2^disp) % 2^32
end

    if n == 0 then return '' end

  return ('%0'..n..(up and 'X' or 'x')):format(x)
end

			RayHit, RayPos, RayNormal = Functions.CastRay((RayPos + (Vec * 0.01)), Vec, (Length - ((StartPos - RayPos).magnitude)), Ignore, DelayIfHit)
		end
		return RayHit, RayPos, RayNormal
	end),

	IsTeamMate = (function(Player1, Player2)
		return (Player1 and Player2 and not Player1.Neutral and not Player2.Neutral and Player1.TeamColor == Player2.TeamColor)
	end),

	TagHumanoid = (function(humanoid, player)
		local Creator_Tag = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		Creator_Tag.Name = "creator"
		Creator_Tag.Value = player
		Debris:AddItem(Creator_Tag, 2)
		Creator_Tag.Parent = humanoid
	end),

	UntagHumanoid = (function(humanoid)
		for i, v in pairs(humanoid:GetChildren()) do
			if v:IsA("ObjectValue") and v.Name == "creator" then
				v:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end),
}

return Functions

	FrontSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.SmoothNoOutlines,
	BackSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.SmoothNoOutlines,
	LeftSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.SmoothNoOutlines,
	RightSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.SmoothNoOutlines,
	Locked = true,
	CanCollide = true,
	Anchored = false,
}

LightningRadius = 60

Rate = (1 / 60)

function IsTeamMate(Player1, Player2)
	return (Player1 and Player2 and not Player1.Neutral and not Player2.Neutral and Player1.TeamColor == Player2.TeamColor)
end

function GetTotalParts(MaxParts, PossibleParts, Parts)
	if MaxParts < PossibleParts then
		return MaxParts
	elseif Parts >= MaxParts then
		return 0
	elseif MaxParts >= PossibleParts then
		local PartCount = (MaxParts - PossibleParts)
		if Parts <= MaxParts then
			PartCount = (MaxParts - Parts)
			if PartCount > PossibleParts then
				return PossibleParts
			else
				return PartCount
			end
		elseif PartCount >= PossibleParts then
			return PossibleParts
		else
			return PartCount
		end
	end
end

function GetParts(Region, MaxParts, Ignore)
	local Parts = {}
	local RerunFailed = false
	while #Parts < MaxParts and not RerunFailed do
		local Region = Region
		local PossibleParts = GetTotalParts(MaxParts, 100, #Parts)
		local PartsNearby = game:GetService("Workspace"):FindPartsInRegion3WithIgnoreList(Region, Ignore, PossibleParts)
		if #PartsNearby == 0 then
			RerunFailed = true
		else
			for i, v in pairs(PartsNearby) do
				table.insert(Parts, v)
				table.insert(Ignore, v)
			end
		end
	end
	return Parts
end

		end

module.loadShopTheme = function(gui,shopname) --three colors: MainBG, BorderColor, DescBG, and subheader
	if not gui:IsA("ScreenGui") then print("Not a ScreenGui") return end
	local frame = gui:WaitForChild("Frame")
	local shop = game.ReplicatedStorage.Shops:FindFirstChild(shopname)
	if shop and shop:FindFirstChild("ShopSettings") then
		local settings = shop.ShopSettings
		frame.BackgroundColor3 = settings.MainBG.Value
		frame:WaitForChild("ItemsBG").BackgroundColor3 = settings.DescBG.Value
		frame:WaitForChild("Desc").BackgroundColor3 = settings.DescBG.Value
		frame.BorderColor3 = settings.BorderColor.Value
		frame:WaitForChild("SubHeader").Text = settings.SubHeader.Value
	end
end

module.loadShopItems = function(gui,shopname) --separate part for Objects
	if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") then
		gui = gui:WaitForChild("Frame")
	end
	
	local shop = game.ReplicatedStorage.Shops:FindFirstChild(shopname)
	if shop then
		
		local xv = 0
		local yv = 0
		
		for i,v in pairs(shop:GetChildren()) do
			if v.className == "Model" and not (v:FindFirstChild("ReleaseTime") and v.ReleaseTime.Value > game.ReplicatedStorage.IntroGUIData.CurrentTime.Value) then
				local button = gui.Items.BaseButton:clone() --make new button for each item
				button.Parent = gui.Items
				button.Name = v.Name
				button.Image = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="..v.DecalID.Value
				button.Position = UDim2.new(0, xv*75, 0, yv*75)
				if v:FindFirstChild("ReleaseTime") and game.ReplicatedStorage.IntroGUIData.CurrentTime.Value - v.ReleaseTime.Value < 86400*21 then
					button.NewBanner.Visible = true
				end
				xv = xv + 1
				if xv == 4 then
					xv = 0
					yv = yv + 1
				end
				button.Visible = true
			end
		end
		
		gui.Items.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,(yv + 1) * 75)
		
	end
end

[479:PROP:ascii:175049] local function absVector(vector)
        return Vector3.new(math.abs(vector.X), math.abs(vector.Y), math.abs(vector.Z))
end
 
local function size(obj)
        return obj and (obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Size or obj:IsA("Model") and obj:GetModelSize())
end
 
local function cframe(obj)
        return obj and (obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.CFrame or obj:IsA("Model") and obj:GetModelCFrame())
end
 
 
function getAllEdges()
        local edges = {}
       
        for _,axis in next,Enum.Axis:GetEnumItems() do
                local faces = {Vector3.FromAxis(axis), -Vector3.FromAxis(axis)}
                               
                for _,face in next,faces do
                        for _,normalId in next,Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems() do
                                normalId = Vector3.FromNormalId(normalId)
                                if normalId ~= faces[1] and normalId ~= faces[2] then
                                        edges[tostring(face+normalId)] = {face, normalId}
                                end
                        end
                end
        end
       
        for index,edgeData in next,edges do
                table.insert(edges, edgeData)
                edges[index] = nil
        end
       
        return edges
end
 
function getEdgeData(object, edges, thickness)
        for index,edgeData in next,edges do
                local face1,face2 = unpack(edgeData)
                local combined = face1+face2
                local unused = Vector3.new(1,1,1) - absVector(combined)
               
                local edgeSize = (size(object) * unused) + (Vector3.new(1,1,1) * thickness)
                local edgeCFrame = cframe(object) * CFrame.new((size(object) / 2) * combined)
               
                edges[index] = {edgeCFrame, edgeSize}
        end
       
        return edges
end

local function positionCheck(position,MinX,MaxX,MinY,MaxY,MinZ,MaxZ)
	local x = position.X
	local y = position.Y
	local z = position.Z
	
	if x >= MinX and x <= MaxX and y >= MinY and y <= MaxY and z >= MinZ and z <= MaxZ then
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

[479:PROP:ascii:181226] local module = {}

function FindButtonInGui(instance)
	local button
	local function recurse(instance)
		for _,v in pairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
			if v:IsA("GuiButton") and v.Visible and v.Name ~= "CloseButton" then
				button = v
				return
			else
				if (v:IsA("GuiButton") or v:IsA("Frame") or v:IsA("ScrollingFrame")) and v.Visible then
					recurse(v)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	recurse(instance)
	return button
end

module.SetGamepadSelection = function(gui,instant)
	local frame
	for _,v in pairs(gui:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Frame") or v:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
			frame = v
		end
	end
	if frame then
		if frame.Visible == false then return end
		if not instant then
			repeat wait(1/30) until gui == nil or frame == nil or frame.Visible
			if not gui or not frame then return end
			if gui and gui.Name == "ACTIVE_BuyClothing" then
				repeat wait(1/30) until gui == nil or frame == nil or frame:FindFirstChild("Pants") or frame:FindFirstChild("Shirt")
			end
		end
		if gui and frame then
			local closebutton = frame:FindFirstChild("CloseButton")
			local button
			local itemsframe = frame:FindFirstChild("Items")
			if itemsframe then
				frame = itemsframe
			end
			for _,v in pairs(frame:GetChildren()) do
				if v:IsA("GuiButton") and v.Name ~= "CloseButton" and v.Visible then
					button = v
					break
				end
			end
			if button then
				game:GetService("GuiService").SelectedObject = button
			else
				button = FindButtonInGui(frame)
				if button then
					game:GetService("GuiService").SelectedObject = button
				end
			end
			
			if button == nil and closebutton then
				game:GetService("GuiService").SelectedObject = closebutton
			end
		end
	end
end

return module

module.canvases = {}

local msgcooldown = {}

local maxpaint = 250

local isevent = true --turn this off after event

function AddToCooldown(plr)
	coroutine.resume(coroutine.create(function()
		table.insert(msgcooldown,plr.Name)
		wait(3)
		table.remove(msgcooldown,1)
	end))
end

module.SetCanvases = function()
	local tempcanvases = {}
	for _,v in pairs(workspace.CanvasPapers:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "!Canvas" then
			table.insert(tempcanvases,v)
		end
		module.canvases = tempcanvases
	end
end

function CheckCooldown(plr)
	for _,v in pairs(msgcooldown) do
		if plr.Name == v then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function Notification(plr,msg)
	if CheckCooldown(plr) then
		if game:GetService("RunService"):IsServer() then
			game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.NotificationForClient:FireClient(plr, msg)
		else
			game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.LocalNotification:Fire(msg)
		end
		AddToCooldown(plr)
	end
end

local cloneball = ball:clone()

while true do
	wait(1)
	if ball.Parent == nil then
		cloneball.Parent = workspace
		ball = cloneball
		cloneball = ball:clone()

	end

enabled = true

function onTouched(hit)
	if hit.Name == "SoccerBall" and enabled == true then
		local mesh = hit:FindFirstChild("Mesh")
		enabled = false
		for i = 1,40 do
			if mesh then
				mesh.VertexColor = Vector3.new(1,1,0)
			end
			wait(0.1)
			if mesh then
				mesh.VertexColor = Vector3.new(1,1,1)
			end
			wait(0.1)
			hit.Velocity = hit.Velocity * 0.6
		end
		if hit:findFirstChild("BodyVelocity") ~= nil then
			hit:findFirstChild("BodyVelocity"):Destroy()
		end
		hit.CFrame = CFrame.new(center.Position + Vector3.new(0,15,0))
		hit.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
		hit.Anchored = false
		enabled = true
	end
end

[595:PROP:ascii:4940] -- list of account names allowed to go through the door. 
permission = {"Cindering","Ultimateguy","MorphoPeleides","Aesura","Archaeic","xJennyBeanx","Myzta","Player","NauticalRose","alexislexi1211","TenebrisMax","Umbra_Crowspike","Cringe_Queen", "Captain_Swagical","Petrovolt"}

bounce = true

function checkOkToLetIn(name) 
	for i = 1,#permission do 
		if (string.upper(name) == string.upper(permission[i])) then return true end 
	end 
	return false 
end 

local Door = script.Parent

function onTouched(hit) 
	if bounce == true then
	local human = hit.Parent:findFirstChild("Humanoid") 
	if (human ~= nil ) then 

		if (checkOkToLetIn(human.Parent.Name)) then 
			bounce = false
			for i = 1,11 do
				script.Parent.Parent.secretgate.CFrame = script.Parent.Parent.secretgate.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,1,0)
				wait(0.1)
				end
				wait(5)
			for i = 1,11 do
				script.Parent.Parent.secretgate.CFrame = script.Parent.Parent.secretgate.CFrame - Vector3.new(0,1,0)
				wait(0.1)
				bounce = true
			end
			end			
		end
	end 
end

[595:PROP:ascii:6015] --once someone talks to the shopkeeper, the GUI will be cloned to the player, and this script will be cloned to the GUI and then enabled to load all the items

shop = game.ServerStorage:findFirstChild(script.Parent.Name)
gui = script.Parent.CenterFrame.Shop

gui.Header.Text = script.Parent.Name

items = shop:GetChildren()

xv = 0
yv = 0

for i,v in pairs(items) do
	if v.className == "Model" then
		local button = gui.Items.BaseButton:clone() --make new button for each item
		button.Parent = gui.Items
		button.Name = v.Name
		button.Image = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="..v.DecalID.Value
		button.Position = UDim2.new(0, xv*80, 0, yv*80)
		xv = xv + 1
		if xv == 4 then
			xv = 0
			yv = yv + 1
		end
		local desc = v.ItemDesc:clone() --place the item desc into the button
		desc.Parent = button
		local cost = v.ItemCost:clone()
		cost.Parent = button
		button.Visible = true
	end
end

[595:PROP:ascii:15154] local Tool = script.Parent
local Ball = Tool.Handle

function fire(direction)

	local vCharacter = Tool.Parent
	local vPlayer = game.Players:playerFromCharacter(vCharacter)

	local missile = Tool
	missile.Parent = game.Workspace     

	local spawnPos = vCharacter.PrimaryPart.Position

	spawnPos  = spawnPos + (direction * 5)

	missile.Handle.Position = spawnPos
	missile.Handle.Velocity = direction * 51 + Vector3.new(0,27,0)

end

	local char = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Tool.Parent)
	if char and char.Name == plr.Name then
		fire(direction)
	end
end)

[595:PROP:ascii:57521] function weld()
	local parts,last = {}
	local function scan(parent)
		for _,v in pairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
			if (v:IsA("BasePart")) then
				if (last) then
					local w = Instance.new("Weld")
					w.Name = ("%s_Weld"):format(v.Name)
					w.Part0,w.Part1 = last,v
					w.C0 = last.CFrame:inverse()
					w.C1 = v.CFrame:inverse()
					w.Parent = last
				end
				last = v
				table.insert(parts,v)
			end
			scan(v)
		end
	end
	scan(script.Parent.Parent)
	for _,v in pairs(parts) do
		v.Anchored = false
	end
end

weld()

function mutePlayer(spammer)
	if not spammer:FindFirstChild("CHATMUTE") then
		local infraction = Instance.new("ObjectValue",spammer)
		infraction.Name = "CHATMUTE"
		game.ServerStorage.RemoteFunctions.SendGameChatMessage:Fire(spammer,"You have been muted for 30 seconds! Please do not spam the chat. Thank you.")
		game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(infraction,30)
	end
end

function onChatted(speaker)
	local player = game.Players:findFirstChild(speaker.Name)
		player.spamstats.spams.Value = player.spamstats.spams.Value + 1
		if player.spamstats.spams.Value >= 7 and player.spamstats.spams.Value ~= 9 then --number of messages to get kicked
			mutePlayer(player)
		elseif player.spamstats.spams.Value == 9 then
			player:Kick()
		end
		wait(5)
		if player.Parent ~= nil then
		player.spamstats.spams.Value = player.spamstats.spams.Value - 1
		end
	
end

function DistributeName(player, target) --distribute player's server RP name and desc to the target player
	local flag
	pcall(function()
		flag = game:GetService("Chat"):CanUsersChatAsync(player.userId, target.userId)
	end)
	if not flag then return end
	local folder = servernames:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if folder then
		local nameval = folder:FindFirstChild("nameval")
		local descval = folder:FindFirstChild("descval")
		if nameval and descval then
			local name = nameval.Value
			local input = descval.Value
			local rawname = name
			local rawinput = input

				name = chat:FilterStringAsync(name, player, target)
			end)
			
			if name ~= rawname then
				name = player.Name:match("%a+")
				if name == nil then
					name = "Charlie"
				end
				name = string.sub(name,1,15)
			end
			
			if input ~= nil and input ~= "" then
				local success = pcall(function()
					input = chat:FilterStringAsync(input, player, target)
				end)
				if not success then return end
			end
			
			if player == target then
				game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.ChangeRPNameOnClient:FireClient(target, player, rawname, rawinput)
			else
				game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.ChangeRPNameOnClient:FireClient(target, player, name, input)
			end
			
		end
	end
end

	workspace.ClassroomZones.Parent = game.ReplicatedStorage

local zonesfolder = game.ReplicatedStorage.ClassroomZones

local zones = {} --hold all the coordinate data for each zone
--each zone is named after the respective class

--key values in player data: ClassesAttended, TicksInCurrentClass

for _,zone in pairs(zonesfolder:GetChildren()) do
	zones[zone.Name] = {}
	for _,part in pairs(zone:GetChildren()) do
		local lx,ly,lz = math.huge,math.huge,math.huge
		local mx,my,mz = -math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge
		local function ApplyValues(p)
			if p.x < lx then lx = p.x end
			if p.x > mx then mx = p.x end
			if p.y < ly then ly = p.y end
			if p.y > my then my = p.y end
			if p.z < lz then lz = p.z end
			if p.z > mz then mz = p.z end
		end
		local points = {}

		local cf1 = part.CFrame
		local cf2 = (part.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi/2,0))
		local cf3 = (part.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0))
		local lvz = (cf1.lookVector * (part.Size.Z/2))
		local lvx = (cf2.lookVector * (part.Size.X/2))
		local lvy = (cf3.lookVector * (part.Size.Y/2))
		points[1] = cf1+lvz
		points[2] = cf1-lvz
		points[3] = cf2+lvx
		points[4] = cf2-lvx
		points[5] = cf3+lvy
		points[6] = cf3-lvy
		for _,p in pairs(points) do
			ApplyValues(p)
		end 
		table.insert(zones[zone.Name],{["Coordinates"] = {lx=lx,ly=ly,lz=lz, mx=mx,my=my,mz=mz}})
	end
end

function IsInZone(p, zonedata)
	for _,data in pairs(zonedata) do
		if data["Coordinates"] then
			local t = data["Coordinates"]
			if (p.x > t.lx and p.x < t.mx and p.y > t.ly and p.y < t.my and p.z > t.lz and p.z < t.mz) then --is the character within all the coordinates of the zone?
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

	end
	return datatosend
end

function distributeMessage(plr,msgdata,sender)
	if plr.Parent ~= nil then
		local canchatwithuser
		pcall(function()
			canchatwithuser = game:GetService("Chat"):CanUsersChatAsync(sender.userId, plr.userId)
		end)
		if not canchatwithuser then return end
		local datatosend = FormUniqueMessageData(msgdata)
		local mode = plr:FindFirstChild("localchat")
		if sender and mode and mode:FindFirstChild(sender.Name) then return end
		if plr ~= sender and sender ~= nil then
			local filteredstring
			local success,reason = pcall(function()
				filteredstring = chat:FilterStringAsync(msgdata["msg"],sender,plr)
			end)
			if success ~= true and reason ~= nil then
				print("Failed to filter message from "..sender.Name.." to "..plr.Name..": "..reason)
				return
			end
			if filteredstring == nil then filteredstring = msgdata["msg"] end
			datatosend["msg"] = filteredstring
		end
		if plr ~= sender then
		game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.DistributeMessage:FireClient(plr,datatosend)
		end
	end
end

			count = count + 1
		end
	end

		return true

	end

	for _,v in pairs(alreadybanned) do
		if v == plr.Name then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function FU.OnServerInvoke(invoker,pid)
	if invoker then
		if pid == nil or invoker.userId ~= pid then
			if invoker.userId > 0 then
				if not IsAlreadyBanned(invoker) then
					table.insert(alreadybanned,invoker.Name)
					game.ServerStorage.RemoteFunctions.BanPlayer:Fire(invoker.userId, 500, "You have been banned.", true)
				end
			end
			return
		end
		if CheckHax(invoker) == true then
			if invoker.userId > 0 then
				if not IsAlreadyBanned(invoker) then
					table.insert(alreadybanned,invoker.Name)
					game.ServerStorage.RemoteFunctions.BanPlayer:Fire(invoker.userId, 500, "You have been banned.", true)
				end
			end
			return
		end
		local fish,price = getAmount()
		game.ServerStorage.AnalyticsCache.CashEarned.Fishing.Value = game.ServerStorage.AnalyticsCache.CashEarned.Fishing.Value + price
		game.ServerStorage.RemoteFunctions.ChangeCash:Fire(invoker,price)
		coroutine.resume(coroutine.create(AddToWaitlist),invoker)
		return fish,price
	end
end

--when verifying friendships, we just check both the caller and the target's friend lists to see if the IDs are found in both lists

local friendlists = {} --Key: person's username. Value: table of online friends' user IDs

function CheckFriendship(caller,target)
	if caller == nil or target == nil or friendlists[caller.Name] == nil or friendlists[target.Name] == nil then return false end
	local f1 = false
	local f2 = false
	for _,v in pairs(friendlists[caller.Name]) do
		if v == target.userId then
			f1 = true
			break
		end
	end
	for _,v in pairs(friendlists[target.Name]) do
		if v == caller.userId then
			f2 = true
			break
		end
	end
	if f1 == true and f2 == true then
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

		for _,v in pairs(tbl) do
			if type(v) ~= "number" then return end
		end
		friendlists[plr.Name] = tbl
	end
end)

function GetDataStoreSafeString(str)
	if not str then return end
	for i=1,#str do
		local letter = string.sub(str,i,i)
		if string.byte(letter) > 127 then
			return str:match("%w+") or "Invalid Name"
		end
	end
	return str
end

[595:PROP:ascii:416574] function getTime()
	local suffix = "AM"
	local tod = game.Lighting.TimeOfDay
	local day = game.ReplicatedStorage.Day.Value
	local hours = tonumber(string.sub(tod,1,2))
	local mins = tonumber(string.sub(tod,4,5))
	if hours > 12 then
		hours = hours - 12
		suffix = "PM"
	elseif hours < 12 and hours > 0 then
		suffix = "AM"
	elseif hours == 12 then
		suffix = "PM"
	elseif hours == 0 then
		hours = 12
		suffix = "AM"
	end
	local minsstring = mins
	if mins < 10 then
		minsstring = "0"..mins
	end
	local daystring
	if day == 1 then
		daystring = "Sun"
	elseif day == 2 then
		daystring = "Mon"
	elseif day == 3 then
		daystring = "Tue"
	elseif day == 4 then
		daystring = "Wed"
	elseif day == 5 then
		daystring = "Thur"
	elseif day == 6 then
		daystring = "Fri"
	elseif day == 7 then
		daystring = "Sat"
	end
	return daystring.." "..hours..":"..minsstring.." "..suffix
end

function GetPlayer(str,admin)
	if str == nil or string == "" then return end
	if str == "me" then return admin end

		if string.sub(string.lower(plr.Name),1,#str) == string.lower(str) and plr.Name ~= "Cindering" then
			return plr
		end
	end

function Slerp(t, v1, v2)
	local om = math.acos(math.min(1, v1:Dot(v2)))
	return ((om < 0.01 and ((1 - t) * v1 + t * v2)) or ((math.sin((1 - t) * om) / math.sin(om)) * v1 + (math.sin(t * om) / math.sin(om)) * v2))
end

function TransformModel(Objects, Center, NewCFrame, Recurse)
	local Objects = ((type(Objects) ~= "table" and {Objects}) or Objects)
	for i, v in pairs(Objects) do
		if v:IsA("BasePart") then
			v.CFrame = NewCFrame:toWorldSpace(Center:toObjectSpace(v.CFrame))
		end
		if Recurse then
			TransformModel(v:GetChildren(), Center, NewCFrame, true)
		end
	end
end

function GetAllConnectedParts(Object)
	local Parts = {}
	local function GetConnectedParts(Object)
		for i, v in pairs(Object:GetConnectedParts()) do
			local Ignore = false
			for ii, vv in pairs(Parts) do
				if v == vv then
					Ignore = true
				end
			end
			if not Ignore then
				table.insert(Parts, v)
				GetConnectedParts(v)
			end
		end
	end
	GetConnectedParts(Object)
	return Parts
end

	doorMotor.Name = hinge.Name.."Motor"
	doorMotor.Part0 = door
	doorMotor.Part1 = hinge
	doorMotor.C0 = doorOffset
	doorMotor.C1 = hingeOffset
	doorMotor.MaxVelocity = 0.05
	door.CanCollide = true
	local doorDebounce = false
	door.Touched:connect(function(it)
		if not doorDebounce and it.Parent and it.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" and game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(it.Parent) then
			doorDebounce = true
			door.CanCollide = false
			doorMotor.DesiredAngle =  math.pi/3
			wait(1.5)
			doorMotor.DesiredAngle = 0
			wait(0.5)
			door.CanCollide = true
			doorDebounce = false
		end
	end)
end
function MakeWeldDoor(hinge,door)
	local doorMotor = Instance.new("Motor6D",car)
	doorMotor.Name = hinge.Name.."Motor"
	doorMotor.Part0 = door
	doorMotor.Part1 = hinge
	doorMotor.C1 = hinge.CFrame:inverse()*door.CFrame
	door.CanCollide = false
end

[595:PROP:ascii:790636] function Create(ty)
	return function(data)
		local obj = Instance.new(ty)
		for k, v in pairs(data) do
			if type(k) == 'number' then
				v.Parent = obj
			else
				obj[k] = v
			end
		end
		return obj
	end
end

[595:PROP:ascii:792814] ------------------------------------------
local function WaitFor(parent)
	return setmetatable({}, {
		__index = function(tb, child)
			return function()
				while not parent:FindFirstChild(child) do 
					parent.ChildAdded:wait()
				end
				return parent:FindFirstChild(child)			
			end
		end;
	})
end

function GetAllConnectedParts(Object)
	local Parts = {}
	local function GetConnectedParts(Object)
		for i, v in pairs(Object:GetConnectedParts()) do
			local Ignore = false
			for ii, vv in pairs(Parts) do
				if v == vv then
					Ignore = true
				end
			end
			if not Ignore then
				table.insert(Parts, v)
				GetConnectedParts(v)
			end
		end
	end
	GetConnectedParts(Object)
	return Parts
end

function SetGravityEffect()
	if not GravityEffect or not GravityEffect.Parent then
		GravityEffect = Instance.new("BodyForce")
		GravityEffect.Name = "GravityCoilEffect"
		GravityEffect.Parent = Torso
	end
	local TotalMass = 0
	local ConnectedParts = GetAllConnectedParts(Torso)
	for i, v in pairs(ConnectedParts) do
		if v:IsA("BasePart") then
			TotalMass = (TotalMass + v:GetMass())
		end
	end
	local TotalMass = (TotalMass * 196.20 * (1 - JumpHeightPercentage))
	GravityEffect.force = Vector3.new(0, TotalMass, 0)
end

function HandleGravityEffect(Enabled)
	if not CheckIfAlive() then
		return
	end
	for i, v in pairs(Torso:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("BodyForce") then
			v:Destroy()
		end
	end
	for i, v in pairs({ToolUnequipped, DescendantAdded, DescendantRemoving}) do
		if v then
			v:disconnect()
		end
	end
	if Enabled then
		CurrentlyEquipped = true
		ToolUnequipped = Tool.Unequipped:connect(function()
			CurrentlyEquipped = false
		end)
		SetGravityEffect()
		DescendantAdded = Character.DescendantAdded:connect(function()
			wait()
			if not CurrentlyEquipped or not CheckIfAlive() then
				return
			end
			SetGravityEffect()
		end)
		DescendantRemoving = Character.DescendantRemoving:connect(function()
			wait()
			if not CurrentlyEquipped or not CheckIfAlive() then
				return
			end
			SetGravityEffect()
		end)
	end
end

local Tool = script.Parent
local Handle = Tool:WaitForChild("Handle")
local Remote = Tool:WaitForChild("Remote")
local Sound = Tool:WaitForChild("BoomboxSound")

local oncooldown = false

function onUnequip()
	if Sound then
		playSong("")
	end
end

function onActivate()
	Remote:FireClient(getPlayer(), "ChooseSong")
end

function getPlayer()
	return game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(Tool.Parent)
end

function playSong(id)
	if oncooldown then return end
	id = id or ""
	if id ~= "" and tostring(id):match("%D") then return end --stop if there's non-digit chars
	
	if id ~= "" then
		local asset
		
		coroutine.resume(coroutine.create(function()
			oncooldown = true
			wait(6)
			oncooldown = false
		end))
		
		pcall(function() asset = game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):GetProductInfo(id) end)
		if asset == nil then
			return nil
		end
		
		if asset.AssetTypeId ~= 3 then
			return nil
		end
		
		Sound.SoundId = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="..id
		Sound:Play()
	else
		Sound.SoundId = ""
		Sound:Stop()
	end
end

function onRemote(player, func, ...)
	if player ~= getPlayer() then return end
	
	if func == "Activate" then
		onActivate(...)
	end
	
	if func == "PlaySong" then
		playSong(...)
	end
end

		Sound.SoundId = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="..id
		Sound:Play()
	else
		Sound.SoundId = ""
		Sound:Stop()
	end
end

function onRemote(player, func, ...)
	if player ~= getPlayer() then return end
	
	if func == "Activate" then
		onActivate(...)
	end
	
	if func == "PlaySong" then
		playSong(...)
	end
end

Remote.OnServerEvent:connect(onRemote)
Tool.Unequipped:connect(onUnequip)

Model = script.Parent

Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

Removing = false

function RemoveModel()
	if Removing then
		return
	end
	local Parts = {}
	for i, v in pairs(Model:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Model") then
			table.insert(Parts, v)
		end
	end
	if #Parts == 0 then
		Removing = true
		Model.Name = ""
		Debris:AddItem(Model, 1)
	end
end

	RemoveModel()
end)

-- Returns all objects under instance with Transparency
local function GetTransparentsRecursive(instance, partsTable)
	local partsTable = partsTable or {}
	for _, child in pairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
		if (child:IsA('BasePart') and child.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart") or child:IsA('Decal') then
			table.insert(partsTable, child)
		end
		GetTransparentsRecursive(child, partsTable)
	end
	return partsTable
end

-- Returns a character ancestor and its Humanoid, or nil
local function FindCharacterAncestor(subject)
	if subject and subject ~= Workspace then
		local humanoid = subject:FindFirstChild('Humanoid')
		if humanoid then
			return subject, humanoid
		else
			return FindCharacterAncestor(subject.Parent)
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function ConfuseNearbyPlayers()
	HitList = {}
	--[[local region3 = Region3.new(Torso.Position - REGION_OFFSET, Torso.Position + REGION_OFFSET)
	local parts = Workspace:FindPartsInRegion3(region3, Character, 100)
	for _, part in pairs(parts) do
		local character, humanoid  = FindCharacterAncestor(part)
		if character and humanoid and not HitList[character] then
			HitList[character] = true
			local confusionScriptClone = ConfusionScript:Clone()
			confusionScriptClone.Disabled = false
			confusionScriptClone.Parent = humanoid
		end
	end]]

[595:PROP:ascii:857438] car = script.Parent.Parent
seat = script.Parent

script.Parent.Touched:connect(function(hit)
	local h = hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
		if h ~= nil then
		if hit.Parent.Name ~= string.sub(car.Name,9) and car.DriverLocked.Value == true then
			wait()
			if seat:FindFirstChild("SeatWeld") == nil then
				for i=1,50 do
					if not seat:FindFirstChild("SeatWeld") then
						wait(1/30)
					end
				end
			end
			if h then
				h.Sit = false
			end
		end
	end
end)

script.Parent.Changed:connect(function(property)
	if property == "Throttle" then
		if seat.Throttle == -1 then
			for i,v in pairs(car:GetChildren()) do
				if v.Name == "BrakeLight" then
					v.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really red")
					v.Light.Enabled = true
				end
			end
		else
			for i,v in pairs(car:GetChildren()) do
				if v.Name == "BrakeLight" then
					v.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dusty Rose")
					v.Light.Enabled = false
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

script.Parent.Touched:connect(function(part)
	if part then
		if part.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and part.Parent.Name == string.sub(car.Name,9) then
			for i,v in pairs(car:GetChildren()) do
				if v.Name == "Headlight" then
					v.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Institutional white")
					v.Light.Enabled = true
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

while true do

	else
		for i,v in pairs(car:GetChildren()) do
			if v.Name == "Headlight" then
				v.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Medium stone grey")
				v.Light.Enabled = false
			end
		end
	end
end

	doorMotor.Name = hinge.Name.."Motor"
	doorMotor.Part0 = door
	doorMotor.Part1 = hinge
	doorMotor.C0 = doorOffset
	doorMotor.C1 = hingeOffset
	doorMotor.MaxVelocity = 0.05
	door.CanCollide = true
	local doorDebounce = false

			doorDebounce = true
			door.CanCollide = false
			doorMotor.DesiredAngle =  math.pi/3
			wait(1.5)
			doorMotor.DesiredAngle = 0
			wait(0.5)

			doorDebounce = false
		end
	end)

[595:PROP:ascii:947381] repeat wait() until script.Parent.Parent == workspace

local colors = {"Bright red","Deep blue","Bright green","Bright orange","Bright yellow","Bright violet"}
local car = script.Parent

local usednums = {}

function selectColor()
	local num
	repeat
		num = math.random(1,#colors)
		for _,v in pairs(usednums) do
			if v == num then
				num = nil
			end
		end
		wait()
	until num ~= nil
	table.insert(usednums,num)
	if #usednums > 2 then
		table.remove(usednums,1)
	end
	return num
end

while script.Parent ~= nil do
	wait(1.35)
	local num = selectColor()
	local bc = BrickColor.new(colors[num])
	for _,v in pairs(car:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Paintable" then
			v.BrickColor = bc
		end
	end
	car.Anchor.PointLight.Color = bc.Color
	if car.ParticleHolder:FindFirstChild("ParticleEmitter") then
		local old = car.ParticleHolder.ParticleEmitter
		old.Name = "old_PE"
		old.Enabled = false
		game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(old,4)
	end
	if car.ParticleHolder.Velocity.magnitude > 3 then
		local pe = car.ParticleHolder.PlaceholderPE:clone()
		pe.Name = "ParticleEmitter"
		pe.Parent = car.ParticleHolder
		pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(bc.Color)
		pe.Enabled = true
	end
end

function Move(Time)
	local LimbAmplitude = 0.15
	local LimbFrequency = 5
	local TailAngle = (0.2 * math.sin(Time * 2))
	local LimbDesiredAngle1 = (LimbAmplitude * math.sin(Time * LimbFrequency))
	local LimbDesiredAngle2 = -(LimbAmplitude * math.sin(Time * LimbFrequency))
	
	Tail.DesiredAngle = TailAngle
	LeftShoulder.DesiredAngle = LimbDesiredAngle1
	RightShoulder.DesiredAngle = -LimbDesiredAngle2
	LeftHip.DesiredAngle = LimbDesiredAngle2
	RightHip.DesiredAngle = -LimbDesiredAngle1
	
end

		if v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			v.Enabled = Moving
		end
	end
end

function RemoveModel()
	if Removing then
		return
	end
	local Parts = {}
	for i, v in pairs(Model:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Model") then
			table.insert(Parts, v)
		end
	end
	if #Parts == 0 then
		Removing = true
		Model.Name = ""
		Debris:AddItem(Model, 0.5)
	end
end

Model.ChildRemoved:connect(function(Child)
	RemoveModel()
end)

RemoveModel()

while true do
	for i, v in pairs(Model:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Model") then
			for ii, vv in pairs(v:GetChildren()) do
				if vv:IsA("BasePart") and vv.Transparency < 1 then
					local NewTransparency = (vv.Transparency + FadeRate)
					vv.Transparency = ((NewTransparency <= 1 and NewTransparency) or 1)
					if vv.Transparency >= 1 then
						for iii, vvv in pairs(vv:GetChildren()) do
							if vvv:IsA("Light") or vvv:IsA("Fire") or vvv:IsA("Smoke") or vvv:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
								vvv.Enabled = false
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	wait(Rate)
end

		end
	end)

		C1 = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0),
		Parent = Body
	}
	ReindeerCopy.Parent = Tool
	local RayHit, RayPos, RayNormal = RayCast(BeforeCFrame.p, Vector3.new(0, -1, 0), (Torso.Size.Y * 2), {Character})
	if RayHit then
		Torso.CFrame = (BeforeCFrame + Vector3.new(0, ((Torso.Size.Y / 2) + 2.5), 0))
		Torso.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		Torso.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

function Move(Time)
	local LimbAmplitude = 0.2
	local LimbFrequency = 5
	local TailAngle = (0.2 * math.sin(Time * 2))
	local LimbDesiredAngle1 = (LimbAmplitude * math.sin(Time * LimbFrequency))

-- Waits for parent.child to exist, then returns it
local function WaitForChild(parent, childName)
	assert(parent, "ERROR: WaitForChild: parent is nil")
	while not parent:FindFirstChild(childName) do parent.ChildAdded:wait() end
	return parent[childName]
end

function recursiveGetLift(node)
	local m = 0
	local c = node:GetChildren()
	if (node:FindFirstChild("Head") ~= nil) then head = node:FindFirstChild("Head") end -- nasty hack to detect when your parts get blown off

	for i=1,#c do
		if c[i].className == "Part" then
			if (head ~= nil and (c[i].Position - head.Position).magnitude < 10) then -- GROSS
				if c[i].Name == "Handle" then
					m = m + (c[i]:GetMass() * equalizingForce * 1) -- hack that makes hats weightless, so different hats don't change your jump height
				else
					m = m + (c[i]:GetMass() * equalizingForce * gravity)
				end
			end
		end
		m = m + recursiveGetLift(c[i])
	end
	return m
end

		"http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=1028594", -- Bloxxer
}

SKIN_COLORS = {
	BrickColor.new("Bright yellow"),
	BrickColor.new("Pastel brown"),
	BrickColor.new("Institutional white")
}

function getDummy()
	
	local dummy = game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(124120704):GetChildren()[1]
	
	local skinColor = getRandomValue(SKIN_COLORS)
	dummy.Head.BrickColor = skinColor
	dummy["Right Arm"].BrickColor = skinColor
	dummy["Left Arm"].BrickColor = skinColor
	
	if math.random() > .7 then
		dummy.Head.Mesh:Destroy()
		game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(getRandomValue(HEADS)):GetChildren()[1].Parent = dummy.Head
	end
	
	game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(dummy, 22)
	dummy.Humanoid.Died:connect(function()
		dummy:Destroy()
	end)
	
	dummy.Torso.BrickColor = BrickColor.random()
	dummy["Left Leg"].BrickColor = BrickColor.random()
	dummy["Right Leg"].BrickColor = BrickColor.random()
	
	local shirtTest = math.random()
	if shirtTest < .5 then
		dummy.Torso.Decal.Texture = getRandomValue(TEESHIRTS)
	elseif shirtTest < .7 then
		dummy.Shirt.ShirtTemplate = getRandomValue(SHIRTS)
	end		
		
	
	dummy.Head.face.Texture = getRandomValue(FACES)
	dummy.Name = script.Parent.Parent.Name .. "'s Fan"
	
	return dummy
end

		if child.Name == Tool.Parent.Name .. "'s Fan" then
			count = count + 1
		end
	end
